protocol.dataset: MoNuSeg official 2018 test, all 14 full images
protocol.xml_rasterization: skimage.draw.polygon using XML X/Y directly; later polygon wins on overlap

protocol.acceptance: no retrospective pass threshold; report every image and both methods
